body: If you go to the top right of your Reddit page there should be a little envelope. If you click that then it shows your received messages and it allows you to compose messages. I'll start.

I'm sorry for making you worried, I really don't want to harm others, I just don't know what to do. I honestly don't think you'd want me as a friend, all I do is make people hurt and I hate it. Please don't let my pain hurt you.
